[Unit]

[Unit]

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=<CMD> ingest --retention-days 30

# easy-personal-ingest.timer
[Unit]
Description=Run easy-personal ingest daily

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
